recent_en: SCBUILD saw a shareholding change recently, with director Loh Boon Ginn increasing his direct stake to 11.58% via an off-market block. The company also announced multiple proposals and released quarterly results for the period ended 31 July 2026.
notable_en: Director Loh Boon Ginn acquired 158,041,651 shares off-market, raising his direct stake to 11.58%.
